newsitem.title: UK: UK's Pearson cautious on S.Africa papers.
newsitem.headline: UK's Pearson cautious on S.Africa papers.

text.p: Britain's Pearson Plc said on Monday that negotiations to acquire an interest in two South African business newspapers owned by Times Media Ltd were "at the earliest possible stage".

A statement issued through Times Media in Johannesburg said the companies were involved in negotiations regarding the possible acquisition by Pearson of an interest in Business Day and the weekly Financial Mail.
TML shareholders were advised to exercise caution pending a further announcement.

A spokeswoman for Pearson, publisher of London's Financial Times, said that the cautionary statement was issued to comply with South African stock market rules and that it did not mean a deal was imminent.
However, South African industry sources said last week that the talks were advanced, with the two companies planning to parcel off TML's business publications into a new jointly-controlled company.
The National Empowerment Consortium, a grouping of black business interests, last month won control of Johnnies Industrial Corporation, which in turn controls TML, by buying a 35 percent stake.
